name: City Council Special Meeting Agenda- Amended
agenda_text:
KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE  AMENDED
  City Council Chambers  12/1/2025 – 1 pm
  31200 Oak Crest Drive  – Adding 2035
  Westlake Village, CA 91361  Strategic Plan
  Survey Results
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 3, 2025 - 6:30 p.m.  Presentation
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81330233596
  Webinar ID: 813 3023 3596
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81330233596# OR 16699009128,,81330233596#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Davis, Pearl,  Halpern,  Mayor  Pro  Tem
  McSweeney, Mayor Honig

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of October 22, 2025 and November 12, 2025 City Council Regular Meetings

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

  1. Presentation of the City of Westlake Village 2025 – 4th Business of the
  Quarter Award - Southern California Orthopedic Institute (SCOI)

  2. 2035 Strategic Plan Survey – Presentation on Results of the 2035 Strategic
  Plan Survey by Timothy McLarney, Ph.D. President True North Research,
  Inc.

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT – COMMUNITY PARK ENTRANCE
  AND RUSSELL RANCH ROAD (COSTCO/MARKET PLACE INTERSECTION) -
  approve grading the slope entrance at the Community Park with American
  Heritage performing the work.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PROTECTED TREE PERMIT NO. 25-002; RESOLUTION NO. 2424-25 – Adopt
  Resolution No. 2424-25, determining Protected Tree Permit No. 25-002 is exempt
  from CEQA and to authorize the removal of one protected coast live oak tree
  located at 2804 Three Springs Drive.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2424-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PROTECTED TREE PERMIT NO. 25-002,
  AUTHORIZING THE REMOVAL OF ONE COAST LIVE OAK TREE AND THE LOCATED
  AT 2804 THREE SPRINGS DRIVE

2.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-005, MODIFICATION NO. 1;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2425-25 – Adopt Resolution No. 2425-25, determining
  Modification No. 1 of Conditional Use Permit No. 23-003, is exempt from CEQA
  and authorizing the sale of alcoholic beverages for on-site and off-site consumption
  in conjunction with a full-service restaurant located at 30770 Russell Ranch Road,
  Suite G (Novo Café).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2425-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 1 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 23-003, RELATIVE TO THE SALE OF BEER, WINE, AND DISTILLED
  SPIRITS FOR ON-SITE AND OFF-SITE CONSUMPTION IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE
  OPERATION OF A RESTAURANT LOCATED 30770 RUSSELL RANCH ROAD, SUITE
  G (NOVO CAFÉ)

3.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 10-002 MODIFICATION 3; RESOLUTION NO.
  2426-25 - Adopt Resolution No. 2426-25, determining Modification No. 3 of
  Conditional Use Permit No. 10-002 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing the
  continued operation of an auto body painting and repair facility located at 31264
  La Baya Drive.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2426-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 3 FOR CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT NO. 10-002, RELATIVE TO THE CONTINUED OPERATION OF AN AUTO
  BODY PAINTING AND REPAIR FACILITY LOCATED AT 31264 LA BAYA DRIVE (THE
  PAINTIN’ PLACE)

4.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 14-015, MODIFICATION NO. 2;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2427-25 – Adopt Resolution No. 2427-25, determining
  Modification No. 2 of Conditional Use Permit No. 14-015, is exempt from CEQA
  and authorizing the continued sale of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption
   in conjunction with a restaurant located at 30770 Russell Ranch Road, Suites E
  and F (Figueroa Mountain Brewing Company).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2427-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 2 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 14-015, RELATIVE TO THE SALE OF BEER AND WINE FOR ON-SITE
  CONSUMPTION FOR FIGUEROA MOUNTAIN BREWING COMPANY LOCATED AT
  30770 RUSSELL RANCH ROAD, SUITES E AND F

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective November 15, 2025 in the
  amount of $355,197.63

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ARTERIAL SYSTEM FINANCING PROGRAM ANNUAL REVIEW –
  FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 - Provided to City Council for information only, and
  no action is necessary.

  2.  ACCEPTANCE OF THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE CIVIC CENTER
  COURTYARD FOUNTAINS DEMOLITION PROJECT; FILE NOTICE OF
  COMPLETION - Accept the Civic Center Courtyard Fountains Demolition
  Project and authorize the City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of
  Completion” for the project on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  APPROVAL OF LEAF BLOWER REBATE PROGRAM GUIDELINES - City
  Council approve the Leaf Blower Rebate Program Guidelines and proceed with
  program implementation beginning on January 1, 2026.

2.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF PURCHASE AGREEMENT WITH
  LANDSCAPE STRUCTURES, INC. - BERNIECE BENNETT PARK
  PLAYGROUND EQUIPMENT - City Council approve a Purchase Agreement with
  LSI in the amount of $318,275.50 and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the
  agreements on behalf of the City contingent upon receiving construction bids on
  December 5, 2025 that will allow the project to proceed within the projected budget
  estimate of $586,275.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  INITIATION OF SAFETY ELEMENT UPDATE – GENERAL PLAN - City Council
  direct staff to seek consultant assistance for the preparation of an update to the
  Hazards Chapter of the General Plan and to return to the City Council for approval
  of the consultant contracts and any needed budget amendment.
 ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Monday, November 24, 2025 at 2:00 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.

Amended agenda posted on Monday, December 1, 2025 at 1:00 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  Deputy City Clerk
  December 1, 2025 - 1pm - Amended Agenda Posted
